<!-- pr-reviewer: 81fc519c2730d93b8f0b083bce6116fcd1ce697c -->
**Needs changes before merge.** There is one small blocker: six of the script's refusals have no test. Everything else checks out. The torch sequence, the compensation side, G40 placement, units and the engine's torch law are all correct. Nothing in the diff can panic, and every other post is unaffected.

### What looks good
- **Torch sequence.** Every contour in all three goldens runs `G0 X Y`, `M200`, then `[M207/M209]`, `G15`, `G16`, the cut, `M205`, `G30`. The torch is never lit on a rapid: the engine refuses one (`cnc_torch.rs:260`), and the script's `onRapid` writes nothing anyway. A section or stream that ends lit is refused (`cnc_torch.rs:267-282`). `laws()` in `plasma_post.rs` pins the order.
- **Refusals reach the gate.** Script refusals go through `message()` into `MESSAGES` and engine warnings, and `posting.rs:454` blocks any post with a warning. The `writeln("(...)")` fallback in `msg()` is unreachable because the engine always defines `message`.
- **Compensation side.** I checked the control golden's geometry. C4 (outer) runs CW and C2 (inner) runs CCW, and both take `G41.1`, which puts the torch on the waste side. C1, the island in C2, runs CW with `G41.1`. Each engage sits on its own line after `G16` and ahead of a straight lead longer than the kerf radius. `G40` sits on its own line before the lead-out, and `M205` follows. Small holes under control mode use the computer offset with no G41, as the generator documents (`motion/plasma/emit.rs:153`), so nothing is offset twice.
- **Units.** `G64 P0.005 Q0.005` is written literally on both G20 and G21. M207/M208 P are in program units (`P0.1496` / `P3.8`). IJ is the absolute centre minus the start point, which matches CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md ("absolute arc center").
- **Non-plasma work.** A milling op, a Plasma Profile with no record, a non-plasma machine and a rotary are each refused by name. Every milling builtin declines the plasma stream with "does not define onTorchOn / onTorchOff". `machine.rs` adds `kind` only for plasma tables. No other post's golden changed: the diff touches only `nc/tormach-plasma/` under `tests/golden`, and conformance passes.
- **No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!`** in the non-test diff. `anchors[k - 1]` in `post/mod.rs` sits behind `k == 0 ||`, so it can't go out of bounds.
- **CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md matches the code:** the record grammar, DELAY in ms becoming `PierceDelay` in s, absent meaning AutoFS, keys cleared at `ENDSECTION`, ON ahead of the engage, OFF after the cancel's lead-out.
- **PR hygiene.** There is a decision record, the provenance lines are present, CHANGELOG.md isn't touched, the body has `Changelog:` and ends `Fixes #671`, and no snapshot PNGs changed. No build.rs, dependency, `.github` or process-file changes (`assets/posts/AGENTS.md` isn't in the PROCESS_VERSION list).

### Local results (merged with main at review time; the merge was clean)
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --no-run` | built |
| `plasma_post` | 5 passed |
| `plasma_post_refusals` | 5 passed |
| `plasma_machine` | 6 passed |
| `plasma_profile` | 7 passed |
| `conformance` | 6 passed |
| `golden_cl` / `machine_library` / `posting` | 24 / 11 / 17 passed |
| camcraft-post (lib 7, all suites) | all passed |
| camcraft-cl | all passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-cl --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Mutation check (local only): I disabled the Z-move refusal in the script and the rapid-while-lit law in `cnc_torch.rs`. `plasma_post_refusals` then failed on both, `want "the control owns the torch height", got []` and `want "a rapid move while C0 is lit", got []`, so those pins hold.

### Requested before merge
1. **Pin the six script refusals that no test reaches.** The body says `plasma_post_refusals` covers "every refusal", and the issue's Done-means asks for the refusals to be pinned. No test contains the message text of any of these, so deleting any one of them leaves the suite green:
   - `assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps:272` "dark": a feed outside a TORCH span. The engine's law doesn't check this, so the script is the only guard against posting a contour with the torch off.
   - `:208` "comp-open": the torch goes out under G41/G42 with no G40.
   - `:297` "comparc": G41/G42 engaging or cancelling on an arc.
   - `:257` "nofeed": a lit move with no feed while the op states one.
   - `:293` "plane": an arc outside XY.
   - `:229` "wear": wear compensation.

   Each is one `refused(...)` line with the existing `section()` helper in `the_post_refuses_what_a_plasma_table_cannot_say`. For example, `refused(&section("", HEAD, CUT).replace("TORCH OFF C0\n", "TORCH OFF C0\nFeed X 0 Y 0 Z 6000 F 2500000\n"), "with the torch off")` covers "dark". `COMP LEFT 750` under `PLASMA KERF1500 CONTROL`, with `TORCH OFF` before any `COMP OFF`, covers "comp-open".

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- `cnc_torch.rs:183`: the check is `0 < f <= 1.0` (a factor), but the message says "(0, 1000]". It should say "(0, 1]", or name the SMALL word's ×1000 scale.
- `tormach-plasma.cps:236-241` / `206-212`: a G41.1/G42.1 that is still pending (COMP read, no lit G1 yet) when the torch goes out isn't refused or cleared. It would be written on the next contour's first G1. If that contour is a small hole under control mode, which the computer already offsets, it would then be offset twice. The current dump can't produce this, but clearing `compWord` in `onTorchOff`, or refusing it there, would close it off.
- `tormach-plasma.cps:176,189-192`: `pending` is never read. The engine always sets `StartX/StartY` (`engine.rs:482`), and after a rapid they equal the rapid target. Either remove it or say why it's kept.
- PathPilot's load-time note "exceeds machine maximum on Z by 0.1496 in" (from `M207 P0.1496` with Z0 at the top of travel) is benign, as the Hub run showed. It's still operator-facing noise on every program. A one-line comment in the program header, or a line in the 1300PL machine notes saying it's expected, would stop an operator chasing it.
- Did the Hub run check that `M207 P3.8` under G21 is read as mm? The manual says M207 takes program units, and the decision record says the same. The load warning on the inch file only confirms the inch side.
- File size: `post/machine.rs` grows from 390 to 404 lines and passes the 400-line mark. `cnc.rs` (1038), `post/mod.rs` (615), `engine.rs` (498) and `posting.rs` were already over and grow a little.
- The `G30` after `M205` also moves XY to the G30 position, as the Hub run showed. It only costs time.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Delta review on the cheap tier (maintainer's instruction); this PR is under the safety floor - the full verdict on the post itself stands from the earlier review(s), this pass covers only the conflict resolution.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** The conflict resolution is correct and the delta adds nothing beyond it.

**Last reviewed head:** `452306af` (delta review, verdict: merge-ready). Delta since then: `d8c0a0ad` (merge of main) and `e9c8bc50` (one-line reorder). Nothing else.

### What the delta contains
- `d8c0a0ad` is a merge of `4865500d`. Its result tree equals what git computes for the same merge, except for the two conflicted files, where the result is the auto-merge with the conflict markers removed. No other file was hand-edited.
- The two conflict regions, both kept:
  - `crates/app/src/posting.rs` BUILTINS: the plasma entry (PR side) and the Doosan DNM and Tormach PathPilot Lathe entries (main side) all survive. No duplicates. LATHE_POSTS gains "Tormach PathPilot Lathe"; PLASMA_POSTS keeps the plasma post.
  - `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs` EXTENSIONS and LATHE_POSTS: `doosan-dnm`, `tormach-lathe` (main) and `tormach-plasma` (PR) all survive.
- `e9c8bc50` moves the "Tormach PathPilot Lathe" entry in BUILTINS and the `tormach-lathe` pin in EXTENSIONS above the plasma entry. Only those two lines change.

### Judgement of the reorder
- It is correct. `every_builtin_registry_entry_compiles` asserts that BUILTINS equals POSTS, then LATHE_POSTS, then PLASMA_POSTS, and `every_builtin_declares_its_controls_file_extension` asserts the same order for EXTENSIONS. Before the reorder both pins were wrong; after it both pass.
- No behaviour changes. Every lookup is by name (`iter().find(|(n,_)| *n == name)`, `contains(&name)`), and names are unique. `BUILTINS.first()` (the default post, the Fanuc entry) is unchanged. The only order-visible effect is the picker's listing, where the lathe posts now appear before the plasma post.
- No machine or extension changes its selected post.

### Trial merge with current main
- `origin/main` is at `2046357b`. The PR head merges with it cleanly (no conflicts, no markers).
- The #844 fallback was not needed: the trial merge builds without it.

### Local results (trial merge of e9c8bc50 with origin/main 2046357b, own worktree)
